metas.name: 1 · ★ 8.1 · 1998 · Horatio Hornblower: The Duel
metas.description: Horatio Hornblower begins his naval career, but a deadly feud with a despicable mate is causing complications.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 8.0 · 1998 · Horatio Hornblower: The Fire Ship
metas.description: While Lt. Hornblower studies for his promotion examination, he is distracted by the serious supply problems that face his crew.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 7.8 · 1999 · Horatio Hornblower: The Duchess and the Devil
metas.description: Lt. Hornblower and his crew are captured by the enemy while escorting a Duchess who has secrets of her own.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 7.9 · 1999 · Horatio Hornblower: The Wrong War
metas.description: Lt. Hornblower and his mates are sent to accompany a doomed royalist invasion of revolutionary France.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 8.1 · 2001 · Hornblower: Mutiny
metas.description: Hornblower and his comrades come under the command of a revered but obviously mentally unstable captain and eventually must mutiny.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 8.1 · 2001 · Horatio Hornblower: Retribution
metas.description: Hornblower and the other officers of the Renown must return to Jamaica to face a court-martial and possible execution for their actions in relieving their unstable captain.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 8.0 · 2003 · Hornblower: Loyalty
metas.description: Hornblower is given a dangerous mission to deliver an emigre French nobleman to a secret rendezvous near Brest while coping with enemy agents in his own ranks.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 7.9 · 2003 · Hornblower: Duty
metas.description: Admiral Pellew interrupts Hornblower's wedding reception and tasks him to locate a British ship which has disappeared off the French coast, where Napoleon's troops are engaged in covert activities.
